description: telemetry.v1 §2.1, §2.2, §2.4: a resolved resource -> its declaration. resource.kind is the authoring kind (stream, state, event, operation; @stream and @state are read as stream and state). Its annotations are either annotations, already resolved, or layers {defaults, kind_defaults, resource}, which a reader merges key by key, resource over kind_defaults over defaults (core §9.3). resource.type is its payload type, null for an operation: {kind: jsonschema, name, schema (the artifact's id), root (the named definition's schema with its $refs followed, as core §9.8 follows them, or null when not needed)}, {kind: raw, media_type} or {kind: protobuf, name, schema}. resource.attachment is its attachment's type in the same form, or null. A type is the profile's Point, Histogram or Epoch when its kind is jsonschema, its name is telemetry.v1.Point, telemetry.v1.Histogram or telemetry.v1.Epoch, and its schema is one of the ids schema.json publishes. expect.declaration is one of: "not_this_profiles" (a stream or state with no key of the vocabulary, kind, unit, buckets or semantic, under telemetry., and not typed by the Point; or an event or an operation that writes none); "ignored" (an event or an operation that writes one, whatever its value); "invalid", with reasons, in this order, each key checked alone and a check that needs a wrong value skipped: kind_value, unit_value, buckets_value, semantic_value (a key present whose value is not one: kind exactly one of counter, gauge, histogram, text, boolean, binary; unit a string of 1 to 64 bytes, each 0x21 to 0x7E; buckets a non-empty array of numbers, strictly ascending as IEEE doubles, -0.0 equal to 0; semantic exactly one of temperature, power, bytes, duration, ratio, count, identity, state), kind_missing (no kind, and the type is not the Point), buckets_without_histogram (valid buckets, and a valid kind other than histogram, or none), histogram_without_buckets (kind histogram, no buckets), not_a_carrier (a valid kind the type cannot carry: the Point carries every kind; the profile's Histogram carries histogram; a raw type carries binary; any other JSON Schema type carries by its root's type, read as a set of names: counter exactly {integer}, gauge a non-empty subset of {integer, number}, boolean exactly {boolean}, text exactly {string}, a root with no type carrying nothing; nothing else carries); or "declared", with carrier (point, or bare), kind (null for a Point that declares none), unit, buckets (as doubles), semantic, each null when absent, and epoch: point for a Point carrier, attachment for a bare counter or histogram whose attachment is the profile's Epoch, else null.
